description: Decode and analyze a PSBT (base64): inputs, outputs, fee and fee rate when the input data is present, estimated vsize, signatures still missing and the next step. Nothing is signed or broadcast. Paid per call. Price: 5 sats or US$0.005 (USDC) per call.

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.
